notes: Toolchain 1.1 candidate (Phase 5C). The exact component set of Toolchain 1.0 (same official upstream archives, same pins), with these deliberate compliance changes decided in Phase 5B: (1) the VHDL-87/93 IEEE libraries (they contain the IEEE 1076.3-1995 numeric_bit/numeric_std sources, distributable only unchanged and not for profit) are removed from both GHDL library copies; (2) the VITAL-95, VITAL-2000 and UPF packages (licence not established) are removed and the GHDL 2008/2019 IEEE library indexes regenerated by GHDL with the upstream rules of libraries/Makefile.inc minus those packages; (3) the 111 openFPGALoader bridge bitstreams (no provenance) are removed from the oss-cad-suite package; (4) the notices and licence texts are corrected (Apio GPL-3.0-or-later, Apio definitions GPL-3.0, Graphviz EPL-1.0 text taken from the package, libwdi text dropped, the licence texts of the bundled native libraries carried in licenses/compliance/). MIX-FPGA runs GHDL with --std=08 only. Everything else is byte-identical to Toolchain 1.0. Not validated until Phase 5C validation and Phase 5A-style acceptance have passed.

environment.notes: Every bundled tool runs with PATH = the operating-system folders only (/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; Apio adds its own package folders), inherited APIO_* and PYTHON* variables removed, and Python bytecode writing disabled so the immutable bundle is never written to. No Python shim is needed on macOS: openXC7's fasm2frames/bit2fasm wrappers run the package's own libexec/python3.12 with PYTHONHOME set to the package, and Apio is a self-contained PyInstaller executable with its own Python 3.14.

components.licenseEvidence: Upstream COPYING.md and doc/licenses.rst of GHDL v6.0.0; the IEEE-2008 packages carry the Apache-2.0 header and LICENSE of the IEEE P1076 WG; bin/ghdl statically links LLVM 22.1.0 (Homebrew LLVM build) and the GNAT 14.2.0 runtime (alire-project GNAT-FSF-builds 14.2.0-1, see the upstream Build-MacOS workflow); lib/ also ships libgnat-14.dylib and libgcc_s.1.1.dylib (GCC 14.2.0 runtime).
